'''Clone cold assault troopers''' were a specialized division of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], equipped with modified armor and equipment to withstand the harsh climates of arctic planets.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Clone_snowtroopers.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Shiv (clone trooper)|Shiv]] and his troopers on [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]]]]
As the name indicates, cold assault troopers were specially trained for battle and survival in extremely cold regions. Their specialized armor was specifically designed for protection to the wearer in extremely low temperatures and to allow for effective operations within this environment.

==History==
Clone cold assault troopers from the [[Devil Dogs]] of the [[44th Special Operations Division]] participated in the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]].<ref name="In Service to the Repulbic">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic]]''</ref>

Clone snowtroopers under Commander [[Mag (clone trooper)|Mag]] were deployed on the icy world of [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]], where they were tasked with testing subzero gear such as the [[CK-6 swoop bike/Legends|Freeco bike]]. After the outpost was wiped out by the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]], another clone cold assault task force from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st]] led by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] was sent to investigate, accompanied by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="TCW:CS">''[[The Clone Wars: Cold Snap]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The armor of clone cold assault troopers is similar in appearance to Imperial [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtrooper]] armor, mostly the chest plate and [[Kama/Legends|kama]] and the [[Flame trooper/Legends|Clone flame trooper]] except white.
